name: Trader in Time — the frame
tagline: Price the wait, shorten it, sell it, write it down
summary: A twelve-chapter book (9 Oct 2026) that states Saheb's method: every claim has a stretch of time nobody can check, and he either shortens it or prices it and holds it. It maps the perpetual, the zk receipt, the royalty and the XR language onto four moves on time, and it is the frame the desk trades by.

ideas.name: Watch how long, not the price
ideas.one_liner: Risk is the unchecked stretch; its price rises with length and opacity.

ideas.name: Four moves on time
ideas.one_liner: Perpetual prices the wait, receipt shortens it, licence sells it, XR writes it down.

ideas.name: Dated opinions
ideas.one_liner: 'This deal loses money by March' is a bet that can be checked.

ideas.name: Loosened by a record
ideas.one_liner: Start limits low; let a clean record earn looser ones.

ideas.name: Roll names, keep bets
ideas.one_liner: GLX became American Perpetual; zkTPU became Cambrian; the bets stay open.

numbers.label: open questions it ends on, incl. 'How does a hunch become a promise?'

name: The trading terminal
tagline: Perp setups by timeframe, sized to the account's rules
summary: A password-gated Cloudflare Worker + D1 in this repository. Pick 1D, 3D or 1W; it ranks Hyperliquid perps by a seven-part score (breakout, momentum, volume, funding, leverage, OI flow, Korea flow), sizes each trade by the tightest of risk ÷ stop, a leverage cap and 0.25% of perp OI, screens long/short pairs by order-book impact (zero-fee trenches) and journals fills against the move since.

ideas.name: Seven-part score
ideas.one_liner: Breakout (weight 3) first; six components confirm or warn; ±100.

ideas.name: Three-limit sizing
ideas.one_liner: Smallest of risk ÷ 1.5-ATR stop, equity × leverage cap, 0.25% of perp OI.

ideas.name: Leverage map
ideas.one_liner: Cross-venue perp OI ÷ market cap: 0.5–10% is fuel, >20% liquidation risk.

ideas.name: Korea flow
ideas.one_liner: Upbit + Bithumb KRW share ÷ global share, TokenPost-style; early help, late fade.

ideas.name: Zero-fee trenches pair impact
ideas.one_liner: Walk Hyperliquid books for a $25k pair; keep pairs under 20 bps.

ideas.name: Fills journal
ideas.one_liner: Move since each fill, P&L and how long ago, owner only.
